[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Melia-chan wasn't the only one who looked[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]After all, Riki is the legendary hero-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Riki knows-mo. She was wearing silver armour-mo.[XENO:n ]

Everyone knows they like each other,[XENO:n ]

They are the perfect match, but if they[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]But now Fiorung has become something else.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]She forgot Shulk-mo. She forgot Dunban too-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]But, Shulk won't give up that easily.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Knowing that he's out there looking for her fills[XENO:n ]
me with hope. I just wish I was there with him...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dunban, watch over them-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Watch over Shulk-mo.[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]That's about all a parent can do-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Ah, that's right. Dunban isn't their parent-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Just that can help you keep going-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Riki raised lots and lots of children-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

world-mo. Don't underestimate Riki-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
